quest.title: Foregone Conclusion
quest.description: You decide to announce the Zhiyi has passed the selection to make him lower his guard. Now all that's left to do is wait...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x750, Primogem x60, Mora x44000, Guide to Prosperity x5, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

talks.objective: Go to Yuehai Pavilion to announce the results

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It looks like we're all here. Well then, time for me to announce the results of the assessment process.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I won't drone on about the importance of the Tianshu role. Suffice to say that Uncle Tian entrusted me with the monumentally important task of assessing the candidates, and now it falls to me to give him a satisfactory answer.

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: All of us here know the score. Don't beat around the bush, just get on with it.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Qianwei has many pioneering ideas, but some of his plans are lacking in detail, and he easily gets into testy exchanges with other people.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Mingbo is reliable, but not quite ambitious enough, and because of his personality, he struggles to win people over.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: In contrast, Zhiyi is evenly balanced across the board, and enjoys an excellent reputation in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: After much consideration, I have decided to recommend Zhiyi to the Liyue Qixing.

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo
dialogues.text: Oh, uh... Congratulations...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Thank you. Honestly, I'm a little surprised to hear my name being announced.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: In my estimation, all three of us are worthy candidates for the Tianshu position. As your competitor, I've become keenly aware of your great talents.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Would either of you entertain the possibility of working with me in the future, and taking on some of my workload?

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: I'll have to see. I'm in a bad mood. This is the last thing I want to be thinking about right now.

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo
dialogues.text: I don't mind... As long as I can help...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Okay, well that's all from me. Zhiyi, you'll have some preparation to do. It won't be long before you're informed of your official appointment. I hope you will work hard and make Uncle Tian proud.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: I will live up to the Tianshu name. On this, you have my word.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: I should go. I need to pack my things and then I think a celebratory meal is in order... Would anyone like to join me?

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: Count me out. I am not in the mood for a celebration.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Zhiyi seems pretty relaxed now. This would be a good time to follow him...

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: Hey, Traveler! Tell me something — what exactly does that guy have that I don't?

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: If you can't answer that, I'm not accepting this result!

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo
dialogues.text: I, uh... also wouldn't mind knowing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! If we get stuck here, we won't be able to leave...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Follow him.

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: Yes, Ma'am.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After finally persuading Qianwei and Mingbo to leave...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... We finally got rid of them...

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: Lady Yelan, Zhiyi has gone towards Feiyun Slope.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Follow him. Quickly.

talks.objective: Go to Feiyun Slope and follow Zhiyi

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, Lady Yelan. We lost him.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: He's too good at this... We weren't able to keep following him without being seen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How the heck did he manage to shake Yelan's subordinates...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I guess Zhiyi didn't let his guard down. Still as vigilant as ever?

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: No, Wupei says he's much more relaxed than usual... Maybe it's just how he's wired. Perceptive enough to sense when he's being watched.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But how...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Don't blame yourselves. Let's not forget he was trained by Uncle Tian himself. Evading detection is not an unusual skill for him to have.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If I'd asked you to tail Uncle Tian, you'd have ended up at a dead end, too. It's fine. So, where did you lose him?

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: Xinyue Kiosk. He only went in briefly. Wupei and I were watching outside the whole time.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: A few moments later, a man dressed in a completely different outfit came out. Wupei had a feeling that it was him, but we couldn't get close enough to check without blowing our cover.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: I figured that if we spooked him, it would undo what we've accomplished today so far. Another option would've been to arrest him there and then... But without any evidence, that would've been meaningless.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: So I stopped Wupei, and I stayed here to wait for you while that meathead went to ask around in Xinyue Kiosk.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Good work.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The fish didn't take the bait, but that's okay. As long as he's still swimming around, we'll find a way to catch him eventually... The key is figuring out what he's trying to achieve.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Let's go to Xinyue Kiosk.

talks.objective: Go to Xinyue Kiosk to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Wupei
dialogues.text: Could you explain to me how that works? A guy like him comes in, changes his whole outfit right under your nose, and you don't even ask him about it?

dialogues.speaker: Heli
dialogues.text: Our customers are free to dress however they please. What grounds would I have to question him?

dialogues.speaker: Wupei
dialogues.text: *sigh* Okay, fair enough, but didn't you think it was just a little bit strange?

dialogues.speaker: Heli
dialogues.text: Maybe I did, but it still doesn't give me the right to stop him...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Enough, let's tone this down a little.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'll make this quick. Just one question: What did he buy while he was here?

dialogues.speaker: Heli
dialogues.text: Oh, he didn't buy anything. He just picked up a bottle of liquor that he ordered ages ago.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: A bottle of liquor?

dialogues.speaker: Heli
dialogues.text: Yes, a very strong kind. Fiery with a rich flavor. Not something the average customer would order.

dialogues.speaker: Heli
dialogues.text: This gentleman ordered it in person from us a long time ago. He was only here today to pick it up.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Liquor... and wineware... I see. Let's go.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where to?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Xigu Antiques.

talks.objective: Go to Xigu Antiques to investigate

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hey, Ms. Linlang, sorry to bother you — Zhiyi ordered a wineware set from you not long ago, right?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We're friends of his. He's been telling us how impressed he is with the quality considering how affordable it was, so we just had to come and take a look for ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Sure. Which model are you looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Um... We don't really know a whole lot about wineware... Let's just go with Zhiyi's choice. Would you be able to show us the one he bought?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Zhiyi picked up his set not long ago. As a quality imitation of an antique wineware set, it has the look and feel of a luxury item.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Just so you're aware, we don't have many of this model left in stock. And now that Mr. Zhiyi has taken one, I'm afraid... it may encourage the price to go up a little.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Price shouldn't be an issue. I'm sure we can work something out. But I'm just a little hazy on one thing — did Zhiyi's wineware set include wine glasses, or...?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: For this set, the wine glasses are sold separately. Minimum purchase is one glass, maximum is four. Mr. Zhiyi bought two.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Okay... Thanks, Linlang. Seems there's a little more to buying wineware than I first thought. We'll have to mull it over.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Well, don't take too long. We could sell out any day now... Alright, see you next time.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You find a quiet place nearby...

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: This is turning into a real headache...

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: I'd just like to point out that we have the self-professed "Grandmaster of Fieldwork" here to thank for being wholly incapable of tailing an ordinary civilian without being seen.

dialogues.speaker: Wupei
dialogues.text: It's not like you did any better!

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: My specialty is information trading, okay? I don't have the physical agility. What's your excuse?

dialogues.speaker: Wupei
dialogues.text: I... ugh... fair point.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yelan, so has the plan failed?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If we can't figure out where Zhiyi went, there's not much we can do... But why was he buying liquor at Xinyue Kiosk anyway? To celebrate?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If so, it's no ordinary celebration.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: First of all, Zhiyi isn't much of a drinker. On some level, he hates alcohol because of what it did to his father.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If he was just looking to celebrate by himself, he wouldn't spend his meager savings on an expensive bottle of alcohol, let alone buy a pair of special wine glasses.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: No, this is a victory feast... held in honor of Zhiyi's private sponsor.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Whoever this person is clearly enjoys hard liquor and has a very high status — hence the need for expensive-looking wineware.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Now, where might we find Fatui who match that description, I wonder?

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: Fatui officials? Should be either the Snezhnayan Embassy or the Northland Bank.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Have both locations surrounded. Take as many people as you need.

dialogues.speaker: Wupei
dialogues.text: Lady Yelan, is it time for us to make our move? If so, you can count me in.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Get with the program, would you? This is a covert surveillance operation. Zhiyi may be vigilant, but that doesn't mean the same is true for his drinking buddy.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: In which case, we don't need to change tactics, just change who we're following.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great idea! So we just need to find out who Zhiyi bought that liquor for and follow them instead!

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: But Lady Yelan, if we get caught, this could become a major diplomatic incident...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'm well aware. But don't you see? Zhiyi is gambling everything on this. If we really want to catch him, we're going to have to accept a little risk ourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Stick to your orders. And make sure we're covering all other bases, too — anywhere else Zhiyi might be going, I want eyes on those locations.

dialogues.speaker: Wenyuan
dialogues.text: ...Yes, Ma'am.

dialogues.speaker: Shanghua
dialogues.text: Don't worry, Lady Yelan. Zhiyi may be a slippery character, but we'll keep a close watch on the movements of all Fatui officials.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I'll be waiting for you at the teahouse.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #If I'm guessing correctly, Fatui officials are likely to take action at night. {NICKNAME}, you should go and get ready, then meet me at Yanshang Teahouse.

talks.objective: Go to Yanshang Teahouse to meet Yelan

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Perfect timing. Wenyuan just sent word that the Fatui Ambassador, Yusupov, just left the embassy alone. He's heading in the direction of Qingxu Pool.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Qingxu Pool? That's the place Zhiyi mentioned in his manifesto...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It looks like that's where they've arranged to meet. Sensible choice, I'll give them that.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Qingxu Pool is always crawling with monsters. Most people wouldn't dream of going there. It's one place they won't need to worry about being seen.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no! We gotta go get them!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Let's go. If my hunch is correct, we just might hit the jackpot this time.

talks.objective: Go to the place Yelan pointed out

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: There's been some work done on this place in the past, but it's a bit of a labyrinth inside. I can't guarantee we'll be safe once we're underground.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The workers left an emergency access route. If we can find it, this will be a much easier journey.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Still... Be ready to fight at any moment. Any resistance needs to be taken out quickly and quietly. We don't want to attract too much attention.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't worry, we're all professionals here!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: By the way, Yelan, where are your three little helpers at?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: They have other things to take care of first. We couldn't afford to wait for them, but they'll join us later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You guys see that? That's gotta be the Fatui Ambassador, here to meet Zhiyi... Looks like he went through that door!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That must be the emergency access route, right? Come on, let's hurry!

talks.objective: Catch up with the suspicious ambassador

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This is the construction workers' emergency access route... but it's closed tight.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Trying to break through would be risky. Let's see if we can find another way.

talks.objective: Catch up with the suspicious ambassador

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The water's gone down... Hey, look, is that another way through?

talks.objective: Move the statue to solve the puzzle
Listen to Zhiyi and Yusupov talk

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Mmm... I can tell from the aroma that this is very fine liquor indeed. I'm impressed.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Come on, bottoms up. After you, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: *coughing* ...Sorry, that went down the wrong way. I've never drunk anything this strong before. It'll take me some getting used to.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: You'll get there. If you want to stay friends with us, you have to drink with us.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: *cough* ...I'll do my best.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: You're more of a lightweight than I thought... Already struggling after one glass?

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: I thought you were made of sterner stuff. You certainly kept it together when you were poisoning your teacher's soup!

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Come on, another round. Less talking, more drinking, haha!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Sure. You didn't leave me much of a choice, though, did you? Just the mention of poisoning sends shivers down my spine.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: I'm more timid than you realize. Every time I poisoned him, I had to hide away at home for a few days because I was so scared of getting caught.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Look, I know it has not been easy for you, my friend. We appreciate all your hard work.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: But I have to say: You really are quite a genius at poisoning people.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: I mean, the poison we brought from Snezhnaya is as strong as this wine, but you found a way to turn it into an imperceptible, slow-acting poison and came up with the idea of delivering it through fish soup.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: What was it you said... Oh yeah. You said "the soup's fishy flavor neutralizes the pungency of the poison, and this process even makes the soup tastier as a result"... Tsk tsk, how did you think of that?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: It struck me one day when I was fishing. I'm lucky it did, otherwise, I'm not sure I would have been able to fool Uncle Tian.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: You have performed excellently! The Fatui will continue to provide the support you need to consolidate your position as Tianshu. Of course, this is as long as you continue to do as we instruct.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Aside from Qingxu Pool, we also have some other requests for you, which we will inform you of in due course.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Don't worry. Whatever tasks you have for me, I will perform them diligently.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you hear that? It was poison... That's why Uncle Tian hasn't been feeling well recently. It's all Zhiyi's doing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a nasty guy! Seize him!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #Hold on. Did you bring a Kamera, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If not, you can use mine. This is quite a scene. We have to capture it for posterity.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You take a picture of Zhiyi drinking with Yusupov...

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Ahhh... Excellent liquor!

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: We've seen no progress on the diplomatic front, and everyone has been eyeing up the treasure of Qingxu Pool. It's been a real headache for me.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: But soon, everything will be taken care of, and I can report back on a successful mission. Thank you, Zhiyi!

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: I remember when I first saw you... I knew right away that you would make a good partner for us. Hey, do you still remember what I said to you?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: How could I forget. You said a lowly commoner like me could never be seen as a serious candidate for the Tianshu, no matter how hard I work.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: "The only way is for you to shine bright in the Tianshu's darkest moment"... I think you were absolutely right.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Yes. Under normal circumstances, the gap between you and other people could only ever grow wider over time.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Just look at your two competitors. Qianwei had wealth, Mingbo had reputation, but you? You had nothing. You were just another nobody!

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: ...And that's why I decided to help you. Yeah, there is an old saying in the Fatui: Give a starving dog a bone, and it'll guard your home for the rest of its life.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Yes, I cannot thank you enough for your generous support.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Hahaha... You know, the best thing about you is that you do as you're told, without complaining. Keep up the good work, and I can assure you, you'll never have to worry about Mora again.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Heck, when you're not in the company of the Fatui, you'll be able to throw your weight around as much as you want. How about that?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Uncle Gao said that Zhiyi has low self-esteem... Seems he was right.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: He was worried that whatever advantage he might have now will diminish over time... so the Fatui persuaded him that he should act while he can.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Do you have any more film in the Kamera?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Plenty.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Then get ready to use it. Tonight's grand finale should be coming up any minute now.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: How well this goes for us depends on how Zhiyi plays his hand.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Is there any more alcohol? Go on, fill me up. I'm in a good mood today, and I'm gonna drink my fill. Make sure to get me home safely afterward.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: There's only a little left. Here, I'll fill your glass. If you like it, I can bring you some more next time.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: *gulp* ...Phwoar, this is the good stuff, it is great...

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Huh? Ugh... *cough* ... *cough* ...What the...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Suddenly, the Fatui official seems to be in pain and slowly drops to the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Zhiyi... You... You poisoned my wine? But when...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: You seem surprised, Mr. Yusupov?

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: You... How could you...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: How could I not? I've sacrificed years of my life studying and reflecting to prepare myself for this position, and in the end I even had to poison my own teacher.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: You really think I'd put myself through all that just to become your little puppet? I don't want to bow down to anyone ever again, and that includes you.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: You imbecile! It's the Fatui who got you to where you are, do you understand? ...If I disappear with no explanation, the embassy will come after you... They'll get to the bottom of this, mark my words!

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Do you see the haystack in the corner? Underneath it is a pile of explosives. And next door in the darkroom are the three undercover agents you sent to infiltrate the Blackcliff Forge.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: I'm gonna stay here till I see you slip into unconsciousness, then I'm gonna set this on fire. Once the flames burn through the hay, they'll ignite the explosives, the ruins will collapse, and everything will be buried.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Wh—What do you hope to...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: I took the liberty of leaving some evidence of your contact with the undercover agents at the Blackcliff Forge. It won't take long for people to join the dots... Two missing-person cases will become one as the "truth" gradually reveals itself.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: The Fatui planted undercover agents in the Blackcliff Forge to steal their signature ruin-grade explosives. Their plan was to blow through the solid floor tiles in the dead of night and seize the treasure of Qingxu Pool.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: *sigh*...But things didn't quite go to plan. Mistakes were made that led to the accidental deaths of the entire crew.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Faced with the overwhelming evidence, the embassy won't investigate this any further. In fact, they'll be only too happy to blame it all on a rogue operation by you.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: It explains why you acted alone, while exonerating the rest of the embassy of any liability.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Of course, none of that will have anything to do with me. When all of this comes to my attention, I'm afraid I'll have no choice but to cancel the Qingxu Pool Redevelopment Plan immediately. I guess then, I'll be Tianshu in my own right, with a clean record and well out of the Fatui's reach.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Haha... Hah.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: Zhiyi, do you really think you're gonna get away with this? The Fatui has a record of everything! That includes the poison, all interactions between us, even my trip here tonight!

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: After I die... they'll come looking... and they'll get to the bottom of this...

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: A record? Oh, you must mean the one in the hands of your second-in-command, Theofan?

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: H—How do you know about that?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Because when you contacted me, I also made contact with your associates. I have Theofan to thank for providing me with the poison I used on you today.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: He'll help me tie up all the loose ends. After all, your untimely demise comes with a few perks for him.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: He has been eyeing your position for a long time now.

dialogues.speaker: Yusupov
dialogues.text: That traitor! *cough* ... *cough* ...Zhiyi, you—

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Shhh. Relax... It's over. After tonight, everyone gets what they want. And anyone else in the know is either my accomplice, or about to be taken out of the picture.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Sweet dreams, Mr. Yusupov.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I did a little surveying on the way here, and found that you'd left yourself three escape routes in case things went south.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I have them all surrounded. If you're thinking of trying anything, save yourself the effort. The game's up.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We were here the whole time and have pictures of everything. They came out pretty nicely, wanna see them?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: "The game's up"? ...Forgive me, I'm not quite sure what you're referring to, Ms. Yelan?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: I happened to discover a Fatui operation here, so I approached them on the pretext of joining forces and eventually brought them down from within. If it pleases you, Ms. Yelan, I'd be only too happy to have you join me in investigating this matter.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This is how you want to play it, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Fine, you do you. All we need to do to convict you is establish that the poison in his system is the same as in Uncle Tian's.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Nothing else you wanted to add? Let's leave it there then. Time to go.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: One wrong move and it all comes crashing down... I should have been more careful.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: You followed him here, didn't you? I was so focused on keeping myself out of sight, I forgot he was a potential liability.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: Let's talk about this, Yelan. I gave you my word that I would live up to the Tianshu name, and that much I can still guarantee.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Your point being?

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: When I take office, I can guarantee that I will act in your best interests. In fact, all of you here tonight can expect very generous treatment in the future.

dialogues.speaker: Zhiyi
dialogues.text: I don't deny that I used underhanded methods to get here. But given my lowly origins, what other choice did I have?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hmph, you still don't get it, do you? Even now.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: #What do you think, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Exactly. Zhiyi, clever people can always come up with a good excuse. But while you might be able to get other people to believe you, you'll never be able to deceive yourself.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: There's nothing wrong with wanting to win other people's respect. But when has Uncle Tian ever looked down on you?

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: He was like a teacher and a father to you, but you chose to repay that by poisoning him... Whatever positive goal you may have started out with, you threw it away in that moment.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Of course, what makes this even crueler is that you managed to convince yourself there was "no other way." Uncle Tian was always going to give you this opportunity... even if you'd done nothing at all.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Out of everyone in the world, he is the one who trusts you the most. So much that he drank your fish soup without doubting you, not for one second.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: #Sorry, things are about to get extremely busy for me. Let's meet at Yanshang Teahouse tomorrow morning, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: I'll have someone remove the explosives. Then, there's someone I have to go and see.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: No. It could be dangerous... You should leave this one to the professionals.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Don't worry. As long as they're willing to cooperate, this'll be a straightforward deal.

response.speaker: Yelan
response.text: Get some rest. See you tomorrow.

choices.text: Uncle Tian has always trusted you.

talks.objective: Wait until after 08:00 the following day

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Ah, there is now no poison left in his system. But recovery from the damage already done will not happen overnight.

dialogues.speaker: Huixin
dialogues.text: Dr. Baizhu, is my father going to be...

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: You needn't worry too much. Keep taking the prescribed medicine, every day, and a full recovery will take at most two to three years.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: It's good we caught it in time. A few days later, and the toxin would've built up in the internal organs. At that point, things would've been much more serious.

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: How did they successfully secure such a seldom-seen poison? It seems the Fatui are extremely resourceful!

dialogues.speaker: Changsheng
dialogues.text: Unfortunately for them, they were up against us.

dialogues.speaker: Baizhu
dialogues.text: Uncle Tian, we'll be heading off now. Remember to get plenty of rest and avoid over-exerting yourself while you're recovering.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I will. Thank you very much.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: #Ah, you're here, too, {NICKNAME}? Thank you for all you've done to resolve this situation. I'll have to make some tea in a moment, you simply have to try it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you feeling any better?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Yes. The exhaustion seems to have gone, and my mind is steadily getting clearer again.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Luckily, it looks like choosing the Tianshu's successor is suddenly not such a pressing issue after all.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Yelan!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: My work is mostly wrapped up, so I thought I'd take a minute to check in here.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The assessment process comes to an end here, Uncle Tian. In my opinion, Zhiyi is not suitable for the position. But Qianwei and Mingbo both have potential.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: You have my gratitude.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...People can change their loyalties easily, I've always known this. But whenever it happens, it's still a dismal experience.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is it just Paimon, or... is Uncle Tian not that surprised?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't underestimate Uncle Tian. He wouldn't have appointed me as assessment officer if he hadn't had his doubts about Zhiyi.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Normally, the Yuehai Pavilion would be responsible for assessing the candidates. Isn't that right, Uncle Tian?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Yes. To be quite honest, I wanted to trust him unreservedly, but I have to be responsible with the position of Tianshu.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: When I first met Zhiyi, I wondered if he had approached me with a hidden agenda, so I secretly investigated him.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: I concluded that he had no ulterior motives whatsoever. He just saw me as an ordinary fishing friend.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: In the end, even he changed... but when did it start?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if none of this had ever happened?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: I never had any plans to recommend him directly, but I always intended to give him the chance to compete on a level playing field. Family background and fame mean everything to many people, but I don't attach great importance to them.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: I had no reputation to speak of when I first became Tianshu. I relied on Ganyu's assistance for all manner of things. What I really admired about Zhiyi was his intelligence and resilience.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I have to admit, he's a smart guy, and very cautious.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The intel suggests that the Fatui saw him as very low risk, but Zhiyi was still extremely careful with the poisoning.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: He chose that specific liquor from Xinyue Kiosk because the fiery flavor would mask the bitterness of the poison, and he chose to wait until the Fatui official was drunk and had his guard down before delivering it to him.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: He also installed a secret compartment in the wine pot he bought to hold the poison. As the amount of liquor went down, he'd shake the pot to release the poison from the compartment into the liquor.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Afterwards, we also found he had an antidote on him. Had the Fatui official grown suspicious, Zhiyi would have drunk the poisoned wine himself, and then found an opportunity to take the antidote shortly afterwards.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But that's still really dangerous...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Yes, had he drunk the poisonous wine, he still would've faced serious health consequences despite taking the antidote. He didn't hesitate to put himself in harm's way to achieve his goal.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: How is Zhiyi now?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Well, I mean, he's sitting in a jail cell. Like Yanfei says, everyone who breaks the law has to pay the price.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Still, he's cooperating. He didn't turn down my offer to strike a deal. I'll make sure there are plenty of guards around to keep him safe from anything the Fatui might be planning.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: A deal? Does this have to do with what you said to him when you arrested him?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Yes. Zhiyi's not the one I'm interested in. If he was as far as this went, I'd have handed the case off to my subordinates as soon as I realized.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: But once the Fatui became involved, things got a whole lot more interesting... I thought I might have the chance to catch a big fish.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: Well, did you?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Almost. Unfortunately, it slipped off the hook at the last second.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uncle Tian, Yelan, what are you talking about? Paimon doesn't understand...

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Zhiyi colluded with the Fatui to try and secure the position of Tianshu. Or, to put it the other way around, the Fatui made an attempt to interfere in the Tianshu selection process.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: With Yusupov in our hands and a statement from Zhiyi, we could afford to continue with a diplomatic offensive.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Also, we'd be able to gain control of Theofan, Yusupov's second-in-command. Then we'd have a pawn in the ranks of the Fatui.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Pawns like this can be major assets. They open up all sorts of new options.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So this was your real plan?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Why else did you think I was investing so much time and effort into this case?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, okay, well... Did your plan succeed?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We got halfway. The first part went off without a hitch, and we passed all the information on to Lady Ningguang.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: But when we tried to make contact with Theofan, he was gone... along with all the evidence.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: The Fatui must be spying on us. Otherwise, they'd never have been able to respond so quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I found out from other sources that the Harbinger "Regrator" got involved.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: The Fatui's main forces aren't concentrated here. Regrator was only treating this as a peripheral concern.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: It's a pity that Theofan got away. But knowing which Harbingers are still looking at Liyue is something. It gives me a starting point for my next mission.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: I have to ask, Yelan, do you have any desire to take over the position of Tianshu yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Tian
dialogues.text: I remember you showed some interest a few days ago at Yanshang Teahouse. In my estimation, you are more than competent.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Oh that... I was obviously joking.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I prefer my current life. There's danger and there's excitement.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Although it'd still be a behind-the-scenes role, as Tianshu, I wouldn't have the chance to get involved in anything truly clandestine or face any real danger.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Alright, I'm done here, time for me to go. I'm heading off again in a few days, and I still have to prepare.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Where are you off to this time?

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: As you might have guessed... Heh, it's for me to know, and you to find out.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: But I'm sure if you keep going as you are, getting yourselves involved in other people's business all the time, you're sure to get caught up in another misadventure before too long.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: Maybe I'll see you the next time danger beckons. Until then, keep your wits about you... A lot of people are watching you for a lot of reasons.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: If you have any more questions, just ask Uncle Tian. After the recent turn of events... I'd say he owes you one, wouldn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo
dialogues.text: So, Zhiyi... is already in prison, I guess?

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: You think? He poisoned Uncle Tian... I still can't believe he'd do that.

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: Why the long face?

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo
dialogues.text: Nothing... I just... I think it's a great shame.

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo
dialogues.text: I always thought... he's very smart. If he became Tianshu... he'd be able to accomplish many things I could never hope to.

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: Don't feel bad. I'll admit that he was a strong contender, but give me three years and I'll overtake him.

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: When I become Tianshu, I'll make you my deputy. Like the sound of that?

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo
dialogues.text: Start by working on your temperamental issues... If you can't keep your cool, your work will suffer.

dialogues.speaker: Mingbo
dialogues.text: Right now... you still have a long way to go before you'll be eligible to take the Tianshu position.

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: I'll get there. One step at a time. And then, before you know it, there'll come a day when you won't be able to find a single flaw in me or my work.

dialogues.speaker: Qianwei
dialogues.text: First things first, though... Let's go and talk to Uncle Tian.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: This is Qingxu Pool. Full of ruins, crawling with monsters... Anyone with any sense steers well clear of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: I've looked into the place before. There's a workers' entrance somewhere around here — follow me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The door is open, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: As I expected. But this shouldn't be too much trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Yelan
dialogues.text: We should be nearly at the bottom now... Let's wrap this up.
